en: Otherwise we'd fall behind the times.
Faced with this impending crisis, we mediated a business alliance to weather these harsh times together.
But now something is threatening to drive our companies apart.
Unless I do something, it could trigger conflict that would lead to one of us faltering.
The president of the other firm is gravely ill.
He has less than a month. Terminal lung cancer.
He was known to be a man of wisdom, and I placed a lot of trust in him.
But now he will need to be replaced, and the next president will be chosen.
Unfortunately, the candidates could prove to be somewhat problematic for us.
There are three of them.
The vice president, a self-made man. The managing director, who rules the Osaka business scene. And a director favored by the president.
Each has what it takes to grasp the reins in their own way.
Another thing they all have in common is their dislike of our firm.
Let's just say they have an aggressive stance.
If one of them becomes the next president, our arrangement would be null and void.
Lines would be drawn between East and West again, pitting all of Honshu against itself.
That's why I'm here in Fukuoka. To seek opportunities with other like-minded companies outside of Kansai.
Mergers and acquisitions, you might say.
And in the event of direct competition, we want as many people on our side as possible.
I've sent people to Nagoya and Sapporo, too.
I hope their talks are going well...
(I'm on the late shift today. It's about time to head in.)
(Hmm, it's getting pretty late.)
Should I get some sleep?
(I think I'll look around town a bit longer.)
(I might find a lead on Daigo.)
(Need to be ready for whatever might happen tomorrow.)
I get the situation.
But I really have no idea where Daigo ran off to.
So, Fourth Chairman. You finally admit who you are.
Forget about my past. Shouldn't you be getting leads on Daigo right now?
Right. There's no sign of him going back to his hotel or getting in another taxi after he left yours.
Could he have gone into hiding somewhere?
There's no reason he would do that.
Then there's only one explanation.
Yes. I think we have to assume he was abducted.
Is the Yamagasa Family behind it?
It's possible. Their footsoldiers don't seem very pleased about the alliance.
I don't know. It just doesn't fit.
What doesn't?
We can speculate all we want, but Chairman Dojima was here as a guest of the Yamagasa Family, right?

They might be willing to pick a fight with low-level suits like us,
but abducting a guest of their patriarch? I don't buy it.
You have a point. I doubt any of the Yamagasa men would be that foolish.
Who could have done it, then?
That's mine, Aizawa. Get it from my jacket for me.
Right away.
This is Morinaga. Yes. Okay... Understood.
What did you just say!?
Okay, I'll be right there. Yes.
What is it, Aniki?
Patriarch Aoyama is taking over as acting chairman.
Acting chairman? But Chairman Dojima's only been gone two days! Why would he do that?
I guess the execs are rushing to finalize the alliance with the Yamagasa Family.
Dammit... Still sounds fishy to me.
There's going to be a meeting at midnight. We should get back to the hotel.
Oh, welcome home.
You're here again?
Mhm. I had the early shift today.
Don't you have your own things to take care of? I'll be fine by myself, really.
Here we go again. Do I really annoy you that much?
No, that's not it. In fact, I appreciate everything you do for me.
Then why do you push me away? Have you met someone else?
Of course not. You know that's not my style.
I don't get it, then. Why do you keep insisting I leave?
I don't see the problem. Isn't it weirder that we're practically living together without even being a couple?
In that case... why don't we become a couple?
I'm ready and waiting, you know.
Sorry... but now's not the time.
Well, I guess I'll have to wait for a good time to come around, then.
Say, Mayumi?
Don't you have any family?
Where'd that come from?
I just realized you've never talked about them before.
Both my parents are long gone. I'm on my own.
I see... Sorry for prying.
Don't worry about it. Now, enough talk. Let's have some dinner.
Fourth Chairman!
I thought I might find you two here.
I came for the same reason as you. I heard Watase from the Omi Alliance was in there.
But why'd you have to...
I was worried you wouldn't be able to keep your cool. It could have easily ended up a bloodbath.
But Watase showing up in Fukuoka has got to be linked to the chairman's disappearance, right?
No, Watase's in the clear. He didn't kidnap Daigo.
And he told you that himself?
Hold on! You're not actually going to believe the word of an Omi boss, are you?
Who else would have a motive!?
He was telling the truth. Watase isn't the type to plot some underhanded scheme.
It's safe to assume he wasn't involved with Daigo's disappearance.
If you say so, I'm sure you're right.
But then who's behind it!?
That's what I wanted to talk to you about.
Do you have a few?
We'll always make time for you, Fourth Chairman. Just give us the word and we'll follow.
Are you ready to fill us in, Fourth Chairman?
I need you to wait just a little longer.
Sorry to keep you waiting. Come with me.
Okay. It won't be long before I'm ready.
All right. We'll be here whenever you're good to go.
Okay. Come with me, then.

So this is the place, huh? Woo-diggity-hoo! See you soon,
Ryoko-chan!
(Damn. It's hard to lose someone on purpose...)
Ah, there you are.
The name's Oyama. I was driving the taxi in front of you earlier.
Oh, that was you? Sorry, I didn't mean to tailgate you like that.
It's just that my passenger was up to something, so I tried to make it look like I lost you. Unfortunately, it didn't go as planned...
Oh, that's okay. I got a similar impression that something was up. So I dropped off the girl I was carrying somewhere else. Made it look like nothing out of the ordinary.
Yep. That girl was all by her lonesome, you see.
She said a stalker was following her, and asked me to shake him loose.
So he really was stalking her, then...

Yeah, and it wasn't the first time, either. Sounds like he's
been at it for a while.

I see. I could tell something was wrong with my passenger
right from the start. But I'm glad the girl is safe.
Indeed. This isn't the first time I've picked her up either. My daughter's around her age, so I guess I feel compelled to see her out of harm's way.
That's good of you...
Well, I'd better get back to work. Thanks for cooperating, eh?
No, thank you.

en: Sorry. I tried my best, but I lost them.
Aw, crap! And I was <Italic>this</Italic> close to figuring out where Ryoko-chan lives!
Why'd you do it, huh!? You lost her on purpose! Didn't you!
Don't be rude, sir. Of course I didn't.
Hmph! You're full of shit. Fine then! This lion's just gonna have to chase his gazelle on foot!
Oh, and I'm never takin' your stinkin' taxi again!
Hold on, sir! Your fare!
Do I know you?
You lost me intentionally back there, right? Thanks for doing that.
Oh, that was you? Sorry, I never wanted to tail you.
Mm, that's okay. I could tell something was up.

Do you have any idea what was going on between our
passengers?
Not much. Mine was a young girl.
She said a stalker was following her, and asked me to shake him off.
Has this happened before?
Apparently this wasn't the first time. It sounds like he's been after her a while.
Thanks to you, nothin' came of it, though.

So that's what he was up to... I knew something about him
was off.
Well, I'm just glad the girl ended up safe.
Shame this sort of thing happens... I've picked this girl up a few times now. She's around my daughter's age, so I wanted to make sure she was all right.
...That's good of you.
Well, I'd better get back to work. Thanks for cooperating.
There's the man. Hey, Suzuki-san!
Oh, Wada-san. How are you feeling?

Better. I appreciate you taking over. Whatever foul plague
was infesting my stomach has started to clear up already.
Okay, then it's back to work for me. Thanks again.
...Kiryu-san. My Mack senses. They speak to me. A decisive moment's in the making, and it's gonna go down nearby!
How can you tell?

Shoot, I've taken so many of these dang photos, it's like I
have a sixth sense! ...For good shots, not ghosts, ya dig.

But yeah! I know a Revelation's about to happen here.
I can feel it rattlin' away in my bones!

You can learn new techniques by witnessing
Revelations around town.

To trigger a Revelation, you'll need to resolve
problems that occur in that locale.

There's no way of knowing what events will
trigger a Revelation, but it pays to try and fix
any sticky situations you come across.

You can also unlock new techniques by using
certain weapons enough times.

The weapons and techniques unlocked differ
from character to character. Try using a variety
of weapons and see what you can discover.
Hold on. Gotta take this real quick.
Our date?
Oh, of course! Our date!
Ahaha! Sorry, honey.
No, I didn't forget! I was just... uh... having a Revelation?
No, no, wait! I was actually on my way right now! Be there fast as I can!
Love you, sweetheart. See you in a few, okay?
My b, Kiryu-san.
Gotta bounce. Something urgent just sprung up.
I do hate to miss a photo op⑬feels like my heart's getting sliced clean in two.
But I know you can do it, Kiryu-san! You're always the man for the job!
Hey, just a minute here...
Adios, amigo!
(He seemed pretty sure something was about to go down here... But what could it be?)
(In any case, I'd better get this cab back over to Nagasu Taxi.)
Hey! You! I need a ride, quick!
*gasp* Follow that cab up ahead! *pant*
What, you gonna turn down a payin' customer!?
I never said that.
Then step on it! They're getting away!
(Refusing a ride might not look good on the company. And he's already pretty agitated... Guess I have no choice.)
Okay, get in.

Make sure you don't let them know we're following them...
Heh, heheheh.

You're gonna lead me right to your doorstep, Ryoko-chan,
my sweet!
(Something's really off about this guy. I should probably let the other taxi get away and make it look like an accident.)
Oh, Suzuki-san. Just the man I wanted to see.
Wada-san? What can I help you with?
So, I was right in the middle of a ride, see, when all of a sudden the bubbleguts got me. Stomach pains, y'know? Anyway they got so bad I had to get up and push out a great big⑬
I think I get the picture. Are you gonna be okay?
Not till it all settles down... down there. Anyway, I explained to the chief that I'm a little backed up, so I'm gonna need some backup.
I know you're technically off-shift, but would you mind taking this passenger for me?
Do you really need me to do it?
I could certainly use the help. I'll go ahead and notify the chief that⑬ Ooh! Oh geez! Owowow!
(Looks like he's in pretty bad shape. He should probably be lying down.)
Okay, you just leave it to me. Go get off your feet as soon as you can.
Whew, I owe ya one... Um, 'scuse me. Another driver will be taking over from here, one of our finest. Will that be all right with you, sir?
I owe you one, Suzuki-san... Ooof.
(Huh? I know this guy...)
Do my eyes deceive me, or is that the baddest cat to ever walk the streets of Japan?
Whoa-ho-ho, I knew it! Kiryu-san! Dude, it's me, Mack Shinozuka! We used to kick it a few years back.
Remember?
(That's right, we have met before. He's a photographer that travels around the world, if I recall correctly. But...)
Sorry, I think you have the wrong guy. I'm Suzuki.
Hahaha, whatever you say, Kiryu-san! Man, it's good to see you again!
Like I said, my name is Suzuki...
Sure is a trip running into you out here! Shouldn't you be in Kamurocho, doing crazy yakuza stuff⑬you know, busting heads, taking names?
(He's not listening... I can't risk anyone hearing this, so I'd better get us both on the road.)
I'll get you where you want to go, sir. Please, hop in.
You got it, Kiryu-san, old buddy!
(<Color:7>Olivier<Color:Default>'s the spot, huh...)
Phew, that was a feast! Man, their sashimi really is somethin' else.
Huh? That you, Suzuki-san?
Yeah, it's me.
Oh. Well what brings ya out here?
Actually... Hirakawa-san asked me to come get you.
What, I stay out too long or somethin'? Sorry 'bout that.
All I remember is I was havin' a mighty good meal, so I ordered some more drinks and... poof! Where's the time all go? Hahaha!
